notes: Your kit's nightly enrichment works through its whole backlog instead of rereading the same notes. It took the oldest unenriched notes each night, and a note with no people or topics in it stayed unenriched after reading, so the same notes led every night's batch and the queue barely moved. Notes it has not read yet now go first.

The health card that says memories are waiting for enrichment counts only notes your kit has not read yet, and no longer counts its own bookkeeping. On one kit 3620 of the 5101 it reported were receipts from the conflict checker, not memories.
